subject: SIG evidence delivery and access checkpoint for Acme Corp
messages:
From: Ben Caldwell <ben.caldwell@acme.com>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>
Cc: security@acme.com
Date: 2027-05-28T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: SIG follow-up: outstanding evidence items

Hi Naomi,

Thanks for taking SIG yesterday. We pulled the outstanding evidence items from the questionnaire and have a short list we'd like to close out this week so our internal reviewers can finish the control assessment:

- Updated network diagram showing VPC/subnet boundaries and egress controls (PDF)
- Incident response runbook for infrastructure (step-by-step, including key rotation and playbooks)
- Console screenshots showing IAM roles and service accounts with last-modified dates (sanitized)
- Encryption at-rest policy (doc) and KMS usage example

Can you confirm which of these are available and whether you can provide Drive links or attachments? Also note we need a signed acceptance that no customer data is included in the screenshots.

Appreciate a quick turnaround — our review is scheduled for 6/2.

Best,
Ben Caldwell
Security Engineering, Acme Corp
(Attachment: acme-sig-missing-items.xlsx)

From: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>
To: Ben Caldwell <ben.caldwell@acme.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-05-28T10:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: SIG follow-up: outstanding evidence items

Hi Ben — thanks for the list and the heads-up on timing. We can deliver everything on that list. Quick plan:

- Network diagram: Marissa will produce a redacted PDF and upload to a shared folder.
- Incident response runbook: Priyom will export the current runbook, redact any customer identifiers, and attach the markdown file.
- IAM screenshots: we will capture console screenshots, sanitize visible account names, and produce a zip with a signed attest statement.
- Encryption/KMS policy: we will share the official policy doc and an example KMS usage snippet.

I'm sharing a temporary Drive folder here for uploads: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1A2B3C-sig-acme-evidence (access set to anyone with link, view only; we will tighten after confirmation).

If you can confirm the share link works for your reviewers, we'll upload a first batch by EOD 5/29 and the final runbook + screenshots by 5/30 morning.

Naomi Feldman
Security & Compliance Lead
Redwood Inference
(Attachment: delivery-plan.txt)

From: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-05-28T10:20:00-07:00
Subject: Action: Acme SIG evidence — access + redaction notes

Team — copying the ask from Acme. Two quick items I need from you both so we can upload a compliant package:

Marissa: can you generate a network diagram that removes any customer-specific subnets and internal hostnames, then export to PDF as network_diagram_redacted.pdf? Acme wants VPC boundaries, egress controls, and a brief caption for how traffic is filtered. Please also capture 2-3 console screenshots illustrating NAT/IGW route tables for the diagram context.

Priyom: please export the incident response runbook (incident_response_runbook_v2.md). Remove playbook entries that reference customer ticket IDs and replace with placeholders. Add a short section at the top with contact matrix and RTO/RPO. Also prepare a short KMS usage snippet and point to the encryption policy doc we store in Legal.

Callout: share link is currently set to anyone-with-link view. Once uploads are in, I will confirm with Ben and then set expiration to 30 days. If you hit any PII/cross-customer references that are non-trivial to redact, flag me immediately.

Thanks — Naomi
(Internal-only)

---
On 2027-05-28 at 09:12 Ben wrote: (see above)

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-05-29T15:40:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Action: Acme SIG evidence — access + redaction notes

Naomi / Priyom — uploaded a first pass to the Drive folder and adjusted share settings to "Anyone with the link (view)". Files added: 

- network_diagram_redacted.pdf (Attachment: network_diagram_redacted.pdf) — redacted hostnames, annotated egress rules.
- iam_screenshots_05-29.zip (Attachment: iam_screenshots_05-29.zip) — contains 3 sanitized console screenshots + a signed_attestation.txt confirming no customer data present.

Notes: one console screenshot showed a service account with a historic comment that referenced an internal customer code. I replaced the comment and noted the replacement in signed_attestation.txt. Priyom: you may want to review the diagram captions — I left TODOs where technical phrasing needs your input.

Marissa Cole
Security Engineer, Redwood Inference
(Attachment: signed_attestation.txt)

From: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>
To: Ben Caldwell <ben.caldwell@acme.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-05-30T08:30:00-07:00
Subject: Final SIG evidence bundle for Acme — uploads + access expiry

Hi Ben — we uploaded the requested evidence to the shared Drive folder and summarized contents below. Please confirm receipt and whether you need any redactions reworked.

Shared folder: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1A2B3C-sig-acme-evidence
Uploaded items (final):
- network_diagram_redacted.pdf (network boundaries, egress controls; redacted hostnames)
- incident_response_runbook_v2.md (runbook with placeholders for customer ticket IDs; contact matrix and RTO/RPO included)
- iam_screenshots_05-29.zip (3 sanitized console screenshots + signed_attestation.txt)
- encryption-policy-202704.pdf (official encryption at-rest policy)
- sig-checklist-acme.csv (completed SIG checklist responses)

Access details: link is view-only, expiring 30 days from today (6/29/2027). If your reviewers require longer access, let me know and we can arrange an extension or an S3-backed signed URL.

If everything looks good we can mark this SIG evidence request as fulfilled in your tracker and in our internal compliance ticket. Next steps from Acme would be any follow-up clarifying questions or a request for on-call availability during their control review.

Thanks — please acknowledge when you have the files.

Naomi Feldman
Security & Compliance Lead
Redwood Inference
(Attachment list: network_diagram_redacted.pdf, incident_response_runbook_v2.md, iam_screenshots_05-29.zip, encryption-policy-202704.pdf, sig-checklist-acme.csv)
